_what: Policy a company deploys to its Macs with a configuration profile, read by computer/managed-settings.mjs. A profile lands as a preferences file for the app's domain; each key listed in `keys` is accepted only with the type given, and every setting is reported with where it came from so the person is told who set it. Keys not listed, or with the wrong type, are ignored and named in `ignored`. A setting is acted on by the owner named in `governs`; adding a key is one row here and a reader in that owner. With no profile nothing is managed and every behaviour is unchanged.

local_models.what: false stops this Mac answering model calls with models served on it

allowed_ais.governs: the AIs the person may connect
allowed_ais.what: ids of the AIs that may be connected; empty or absent allows all

sign_in_methods.what: the sign-in methods offered; empty or absent offers all

usage_sharing.what: false keeps usage data on this Mac

words.off: Your organisation turned {key} off on this Mac ({source}).
words.ignored_key: {key} is not a setting this app reads.
